title: Shoonya: Zero-Socket In-Process Small Language Models for Graph Databases with Schema-Epoch KV Caching, Live Catalog Logit Masking, and Verifier-Advantage Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28502v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coupling a property-graph database to an external language-model server imposes a three-part socket tax: serialization overhead dwarfing microsecond graph reads, repeated prefill of verbose schemas, and blind decoding divorced from the live catalog and multi-version concurrency control (MVCC) engine. We present Shoonya, from-scratch commercially clean (0.0% non-commercial or share-alike data) tri-modal (Python, Rust, OpenCypher) small language models (16.8M to 1.07B parameters) co-designed with shoonya-infer, a zero-dependency pure-Rust runtime embedded inside the samyama-graph-enterprise address space. Direct GraphStore references unlock three database-native primitives: (1) an epoch-invalidated SchemaPrefixCache over a copy-on-write PagedKvArena accelerating warm CPU time-to-first-token by 4.91x--13.68x with O(1) DDL invalidation; (2) a 36 us columnar catalog and source-span logit mask enforcing valid ontology identifiers and verbati

translated_title: Shoonya：面向图数据库的零套接字进程内小型语言模型，具备模式纪元KV缓存、实时目录Logit掩码与验证器优势蒸馏
translated_abstract: 将属性图数据库与外部语言模型服务器耦合会带来三重“套接字税”：远超微秒级图读取的序列化开销、对冗长模式的重复预填充，以及脱离实时目录和多版本并发控制（MVCC）引擎的盲目解码。我们提出了Shoonya——一组从零开始训练、商业纯净（0.0%非商业或相同方式共享数据）的三模态（Python、Rust、OpenCypher）小型语言模型（参数量从1680万到10.7亿），并与shoonya-infer协同设计，后者是一个嵌入在samyama-graph-enterprise地址空间内的零依赖纯Rust运行时。直接的GraphStore引用解锁了三个数据库原生原语：(1) 构建在写时复制PagedKvArena之上的纪元失效SchemaPrefixCache，将热CPU状态下的首令牌生成时间加速4.91至13.68倍，并具备O(1)的DDL失效能力；(2) 36微秒的列式目录与源码跨度Logit掩码，强制执行有效的本体标识符和逐字……
tldr: Shoonya将小型语言模型直接嵌入图数据库进程内运行，通过模式纪元KV缓存、实时目录Logit掩码和验证器优势蒸馏三大数据库原生技术消除外部LLM服务器的套接字开销，使首令牌生成时间加速最高13.68倍。
en_tdlr: Shoonya embeds small language models in-process within graph databases, eliminating the socket tax of external LLM servers via three database-native techniques—schema-epoch KV caching, live catalog logit masking, and verifier-advantage distillation—accelerating time-to-first-token by up to 13.68x.
